'''Columi Mental Hoverpods''' were essentially floating metal chairs which could move in response to mental commands. Each pod was 3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and equipped with a fusion [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. It could hold only one person but also carry 50 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo. It could hover 3 meters off the ground and move 120 kmh. It cost 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

While originally only the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]]&mdash;who created the pods&mdash;could use them, technological advances resulted in versions for [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] and [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]. Some beings who operated the pods experienced side effects, such as nausea, unless they took a stabilizing serum.
